title: The Fall of Jerusalem

questions.question: Who besieged Jerusalem in the ninth year of Zedekiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:1 (ESV): "...Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came with all his army against Jerusalem and laid siege to it."

questions.question: What happened to Zedekiah when he tried to flee?
options: The Chaldeans captured him, killed his sons, put out his eyes, and took him to Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: The Chaldeans captured him, killed his sons, put out his eyes, and took him to Babylon
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:5-7 (ESV): "...and they slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah... and put out the eyes of Zedekiah and bound him in chains and took him to Babylon."

questions.question: What did Nebuzaradan do to the temple and Jerusalem?
options: He burned the house of the LORD, the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and broke down the walls
questions.correctAnswer: He burned the house of the LORD, the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and broke down the walls
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:9-10 (ESV): "And he burned the house of the LORD... and the army... broke down the walls around Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who was appointed governor over the people left in Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:22 (ESV): "And over the people who remained... Nebuchadnezzar... appointed Gedaliah..."

questions.question: What happened to Jehoiachin in the thirty-seventh year of his exile?
options: Evil-merodach king of Babylon released him from prison and treated him kindly
questions.correctAnswer: Evil-merodach king of Babylon released him from prison and treated him kindly
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:27-28 (ESV): "...Evil-merodach... graciously freed Jehoiachin... and spoke kindly to him..."

questions.question: Who killed Gedaliah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:25 (ESV): "...Ishmael... came... and struck down Gedaliah..."

questions.question: Where did the people go after Gedaliah was killed?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:26 (ESV): "And all the people... arose and went to Egypt, for they were afraid of the Chaldeans."

questions.question: What did the Chaldeans do with the bronze pillars, stands, and sea?
options: They broke them in pieces and carried the bronze to Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: They broke them in pieces and carried the bronze to Babylon
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:13 (ESV): "And the pillars of bronze... the Chaldeans broke in pieces and carried the bronze to Babylon."

questions.question: Who was the chief priest killed by the king of Babylon?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:18, 21 (ESV): "And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest... And the king of Babylon struck them down..."

questions.question: By which way did the men of war flee Jerusalem?
options: By the gate between the two walls, by the king's garden
questions.correctAnswer: By the gate between the two walls, by the king's garden
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:4 (ESV): "...the king and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, by the king's garden..."

questions.question: Where was Zedekiah captured?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:5 (ESV): "But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho..."

questions.question: Where was judgment passed on Zedekiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:6 (ESV): "And they captured the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah..."

questions.question: How long did the siege last?
options: Until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah
questions.correctAnswer: Until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:2 (ESV): "So the city was besieged till the eleventh year of King Zedekiah."

questions.question: Who was the captain of the guard?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:8 (ESV): "...came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard..."

questions.question: What did Jehoiachin receive daily from the king of Babylon?
options: A regular allowance for every day of his life
questions.correctAnswer: A regular allowance for every day of his life
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 25:30 (ESV): "And a regular allowance was given him by the king... as long as he lived."

key_verse_text: And the king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was taken into exile out of its land. (ESV)
